Although I honestly wanted to see myself in Gryffindor like the Golden Trio... I knew, deep down, that I would most likely be in Ravenclaw. (Pottermore sorted me to Ravenclaw.. so... maybe I was right.) Was there any house that you just knew would be your house?
Be honest: while reading the books, which house did you most connect with?

While reading, I mostly heard about Gryffindors, as most of us did, so when I was young and reading the series my first time, I saw myself as a Gryffindor. It helped that Hermione was such a book worm. After rereading it a few times I started feeling more like a Ravenclaw and I also get sorted into Ravenclaw a lot of the time I take tests. Now when I look at myself and the houses objectively, which characteristics they promote that I have, I feel torn between Slytherin and Ravenclaw. And there's a fifty/fifty split which one I sort into.

I wanted to see myself as a Ravenclaw, but if I'm being honest...I most identified with Hufflepuff. (Which works out well, given the fact that I was sorted into Hufflepuff on Pottermore.) Growing up, I felt like an outsider and klutz, but I was a fierce friend. Still am, I hope! haha I've strived to be as good to my peers as I possibly can, honestly sometimes to my own detriment. But, their loyalty and overall kindness to those around them was what really gripped me from that house.
i don't think i can say it better than you. any test i take i get sorted into hufflepuff. i kind of feel like it is the least explored house and i like that as well.
I am completely a slytherin. I did want to be a Gryffindor though.
